items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: James Monroe. Then, unfortunately, I had to leave. The Dean called me in and said, “Palmieri, you either leave or we throw you out.”

ctx.x: While we were on break, you mentioned your high school experience. Do you want to talk about your high school... It was James...
James Monroe. Then, unfortunately, I had to leave. The Dean called me in and said, “Palmieri, you either leave or we throw you out.”
So you never finished high school?
